what_constrained: Shared emulator could retain another active watchface after successful installation.
what_worked: Independent visual review caught invalid Gabbro evidence; explicit activation plus capture identity guards resolved it. Pure C sanitizer tests isolated gesture and pose policy.
what_differently: Assert active-face identity before native evidence collection rather than accepting dimensions and install success.

what_constrained: Watchfaces cannot receive touchscreen input; very short QEMU impulse fixtures were intermittent.
what_worked: Axis-independent raw case-knock policy, timestamp tests, bounded persistence polling and independent green-contrast review.
what_differently: Separate synthetic-path evidence from physical tap sensitivity; probe new settings before trusting an old active face.

what_constrained: Need exact native GIFs on three display types without rebuilding the reviewed upload or duplicating a publication.
what_worked: Native fixture media, guarded exact-byte API submission, public device-selector evidence, independent media/PBW hash review.
what_differently: Remember the public live-watch placeholder duplicates the lead image and shifts image alt numbering.
